what: Eclipse ring at the panel center — radius 125 (for a 300 panel) plus three sines (1 × sin(.4t) · 3 × sin(9θ + .6t) · 2 × sin(5θ − .35t)) so it ripples nonstop, and when the cursor comes within 400px of the panel center it swells up to 18 toward the cursor (cos² shape). The swell’s direction and strength follow 5% of the remaining gap each frame. The ring is a background-color disc (80% diameter) laid over a 4px-blur disc, leaving only the rim.

options.bulge: Max amount it swells toward the cursor (on a 300 panel), default 18 — at 0 it ignores the cursor
options.reach: Distance at which the cursor is felt (px), default 400
options.radius: Ring radius (based on the 300 board), default 125

use: · Text or an icon placed inside sits at the center of the ring
note: The original reduces drawing to 90 dots at 30fps on phones (coarse pointer) — this part does the same. It pauses off screen
